name: Dry matter
definition: Mass fraction remaining after drying to constant mass. The drying TEMPERATURE is a method, recorded on the measurement - 105 C and 60 C give different figures for the same material. Sources write DM, TS or DS. Reported on fresh basis

name: Moisture
definition: Watergehalte zoals de bron het rapporteert. Apart geregistreerd van droge stof omdat bronnen het zo geven - niet afleiden, alleen vastleggen wat er staat

name: Ash
definition: Mineral residue after incineration. The ashing TEMPERATURE is a method, recorded on the measurement

name: Organic matter
definition: Droge stof min as. Bronnen over anaerobe vergisting schrijven hier vaak VS - leg de term van de bron vast in notes

name: Crude protein
definition: Total nitrogen multiplied by a protein factor, usually 6,25. INFOODS calls this PROCNT, protein calculated from total nitrogen. The FACTOR is an expression rather than a method - record it in the measurement notes until an expression axis exists

name: Total nitrogen
definition: Kjeldahl- of Dumas-stikstof zelf, zonder eiwitfactor. Registreer dit wanneer de bron N geeft en niet het eiwit

name: True protein
definition: Eiwit bepaald als som van aminozuren of na aftrek van niet-eiwitstikstof. Een ander object dan ruw eiwit, niet een betere meting ervan

name: Total fat
definition: Total lipid. WHICH EXTRACTION was used is a METHOD, recorded on the measurement - diethyl ether (what the Weende scheme calls crude fat), petroleum ether, or acid hydrolysis, which recovers bound lipids the plain ether extract leaves behind and reads systematically higher. INFOODS separates FAT from FATCE on the same grounds

name: Crude fibre
definition: The Weende crude-fibre fraction, and it is genuinely Weende-specific: there is no method-independent thing it could mean. It is NOT a worse measurement of fibre than NDF - it is a DIFFERENT fraction, losing most hemicellulose and part of the lignin. INFOODS carries it as FIBC

name: Nitrogen-free extract
definition: The by-difference carbohydrate remainder of the Weende partition. A calculation by the source, not a determination - record it with value_origin = calculated. INFOODS has the same concept as CHOAVLDF

name: Neutral detergent fibre (NDF)
definition: Van Soest-celwand - cellulose plus hemicellulose plus lignine. Vermeld in notes of de bron aNDF of aNDFom bedoelt

name: Acid detergent fibre (ADF)
definition: Van Soest - cellulose plus lignine

name: Cellulose
definition: Alleen wanneer de bron cellulose zelf rapporteert. Niet afleiden uit ADF min ADL - dat is een berekening en hoort in de modellaag

name: Hemicellulose
definition: Alleen wanneer de bron hemicellulose zelf rapporteert. Niet afleiden uit NDF min ADF

name: Lignin
definition: Lignin. WHICH DETERMINATION was used is a METHOD, recorded on the measurement - acid detergent lignin (Van Soest), Klason, or permanganate. They give different numbers for the same analyte, so a value from a table headed only Lignin is recorded with method unknown rather than assigned to one

name: Pectin
definition: Pectinegehalte zoals de bron het bepaalt

name: Total dietary fibre
definition: AOAC-voedingsvezel. Niet uitwisselbaar met NDF of ruwe celstof

name: Starch
definition: Zetmeelgehalte zoals de bron het bepaalt

name: Total sugars
definition: Som van vrije mono- en disachariden zoals de bron ze bepaalt

name: Glucose
definition: Vrije glucose

name: Fructose
definition: Vrije fructose

name: Sucrose
definition: Sacharose

name: Lactose
definition: Lactose - relevant voor zuivel- en weistromen

name: Gross calorific value (HHV)
definition: Higher heating value (HHV), ook bruto-energie (GE) in voederwaardebronnen

name: Net calorific value (LHV)
definition: Lower heating value (LHV), netto verbrandingswaarde

name: Total carbon (C)
definition: Totale koolstof, doorgaans elementair bepaald

name: Carbon-to-nitrogen ratio (C/N)
definition: Verhouding totale koolstof tot totale stikstof zoals de bron ze geeft. Basis is n.a.

name: Phosphorus (P)
definition: Fosfor uitgedrukt als element P. Wordt de waarde als P2O5 gerapporteerd, gebruik phosphorus_p2o5

name: Phosphorus (as P2O5)
definition: Fosfor uitgedrukt als fosforpentoxide, de gangbare agronomische vorm. Een andere gerapporteerde grootheid dan P, niet een andere eenheid

name: Potassium (K)
definition: Kalium uitgedrukt als element K

name: Potassium (as K2O)
definition: Kalium uitgedrukt als kaliumoxide, de gangbare agronomische vorm

name: Calcium (Ca)
definition: Calcium als element Ca

name: Magnesium (Mg)
definition: Magnesium als element Mg

name: Sodium (Na)
definition: Natrium als element Na

name: Sulphur (S)
definition: Zwavel als element S

name: Chloride (water-soluble)
definition: Chloride

name: Iron (Fe)
definition: IJzer als element Fe

name: Zinc (Zn)
definition: Zink als element Zn

name: Copper (Cu)
definition: Koper als element Cu

name: Manganese (Mn)
definition: Mangaan als element Mn

name: Cadmium (Cd)
definition: Cadmium - zwaar metaal, bepalend voor toelaatbare toepassingen

name: Lead (Pb)
definition: Lood - zwaar metaal

name: Mercury (Hg)
definition: Kwik - zwaar metaal

name: Arsenic (As)
definition: Arseen

name: Chromium (Cr)
definition: Chroom, totaal tenzij de bron een species noemt

name: Nickel (Ni)
definition: Nikkel

name: pH
definition: pH van de stof of van een gestandaardiseerd extract. De extractiemethode van de bron hoort in notes. Basis is n.a.

name: Total polyphenols
definition: Totale fenolen, doorgaans als gallinezuurequivalent (GAE). Het equivalent van de bron hoort in notes

name: Chemical oxygen demand (COD)
definition: CZV of COD - relevant voor vloeibare stromen zoals wei en proceswater

name: Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5)
definition: BZV of BOD5

name: Bulk density
definition: Stortgewicht van het materiaal zoals gemeten. Bepalend voor de transportlaag van het model

name: Median particle size (d50)
definition: Mediane deeltjesgrootte

name: Water-holding capacity
definition: Gram water per gram droge stof die het materiaal vasthoudt

name: Electrical conductivity
definition: EC van een gestandaardiseerd extract. Extractiemethode in notes

name: Water activity (aw)
definition: aw-waarde. Bepalend voor houdbaarheid en microbiologische stabiliteit. Basis is n.a.

name: Hydrogen (H)
definition: Elementaire waterstof uit de ultieme analyse. Standaard gerapporteerd naast C, N, O en S door verbrandingsgerichte bronnen zoals Phyllis2

name: Oxygen (O)
definition: Elementaire zuurstof uit de ultieme analyse. Doorgaans als verschil bepaald in plaats van gemeten - leg vast wat de bron zegt

name: Volatile matter
definition: Proximate-analyse - massaverlies bij verhitten zonder zuurstof, doorgaans bij 900 graden C. NIET de basis volatile_solids en NIET organische stof

name: Fixed carbon
definition: Proximate-analyse-restpost - 100 min vocht min as min vluchtige bestanddelen. Een verschilberekening van de bron, geen meting

name: Chlorine (total Cl)
definition: Totaal chloor uit elementaire analyse. Een andere bepaling dan chloride, dat de wateroplosbare Cl-ionen meet - beide bestaan naast elkaar

name: Insoluble ash
definition: Zoutzuur-onoplosbaar asresidu, een maat voor grond- en zandinsleep. Voederwaardetabellen rapporteren dit naast ruw as

name: Tannins
definition: Condensed and hydrolysable tannins. Sources usually express them as a tannic acid equivalent - record the equivalent in the measurement notes. INFOODS nests Tannins under Bioactive constituents

name: Glucosinolates
definition: Total glucosinolates. The characteristic secondary metabolite of brassica and of rapeseed meal, and a constraint on feed use - which is why it belongs in the catalogue rather than in prose

name: Selenium (Se)
definition: Selenium as element Se

name: Condensed tannins
definition: Condensed tannins (proanthocyanidins), usually as a catechin equivalent. A DIFFERENT FRACTION from total tannins, not another way of measuring them - so its own parameter

name: Ash deformation temperature (DT)
definition: The first characteristic temperature of the ash melting sequence (deformation). Determined under oxidising or reducing conditions and the two differ - the condition is a METHOD, recorded on the measurement

name: Bale density
definition: Density of the material as baled. A different quantity from bulk density (loose) and from particle density - a baler changes it and the material does not

name: Particle density
definition: Density of an individual particle, excluding the void space between particles

name: Basic density
definition: Oven-dry mass divided by green volume

name: Lysine
definition: An essential amino acid, and the first limiting one in most cereal streams

name: Methionine
definition: An essential sulphur amino acid

name: Cystine
definition: Reported by feed tables as CYS, which is cystine or cysteine plus half-cystine - the source's wording goes in the measurement notes

name: Threonine
definition: An essential amino acid

name: Tryptophan
definition: An essential amino acid

name: Isoleucine
definition: An essential branched-chain amino acid

name: Arginine
definition: An essential amino acid for poultry

name: Phenylalanine
definition: An essential aromatic amino acid

name: Histidine
definition: An essential amino acid

name: Leucine
definition: An essential branched-chain amino acid

name: Tyrosine
definition: A non-essential aromatic amino acid

name: Valine
definition: An essential branched-chain amino acid

name: Alanine
definition: A non-essential amino acid

name: Aspartic acid
definition: Reported as ASP, which in a hydrolysate is aspartic acid plus asparagine

name: Glutamic acid
definition: Reported as GLU, which in a hydrolysate is glutamic acid plus glutamine

name: Glycine
definition: A non-essential amino acid

name: Proline
definition: A non-essential amino acid

name: Serine
definition: A non-essential amino acid

name: Total amino acids
definition: The sum of the individual amino acids as the source reports it, NOT a figure to recompute - a source's own sum reflects which amino acids it measured

name: Bromine (Br)
definition: Total bromine from elemental analysis. Reported by solid-biofuel characterisation beside chlorine and fluorine - the halogen set that decides corrosion and flue-gas treatment

name: Fluorine (F)
definition: Total fluorine from elemental analysis. Often reported as below a detection limit rather than as a number - a censored value BioMobi has no way to store, so those are left out and noted

name: Fatty acids, C10 and shorter
definition: The short-chain fraction, reported by feed tables as a single lumped figure

name: Lauric acid (C12:0)
definition: Saturated, twelve carbons

name: Myristic acid (C14:0)
definition: Saturated, fourteen carbons

name: Palmitic acid (C16:0)
definition: Saturated, sixteen carbons - the dominant saturated fatty acid in animal fat

name: Palmitoleic acid (C16:1)
definition: Monounsaturated, sixteen carbons

name: Stearic acid (C18:0)
definition: Saturated, eighteen carbons

name: Oleic acid (C18:1)
definition: Monounsaturated, eighteen carbons - usually the largest single fatty acid present

name: Linoleic acid (C18:2)
definition: Polyunsaturated, and the one CVB grades animal fat by: its 6% and 9% linoleic variants are two products, not two measurements

name: Linolenic acid (C18:3)
definition: Polyunsaturated, three double bonds

name: Fatty acids, C20 and longer
definition: The long-chain fraction, reported as a single lumped figure

name: Total fatty acids
definition: The source's own sum of the fatty acids it measured. NOT to be recomputed - a sum reflects which acids that source looked for

name: Ash shrinkage temperature
definition: The first contraction of the test cone. EUROPEAN STANDARD ONLY - the American method has no counterpart, which is why it is its own parameter and not a method variant of deformation

name: Ash softening temperature
definition: The cone has slumped to a sphere (height = base width). ASTM calls it softening or spherical. Distinct from the hemispherical point, where height is half the width

name: Ash hemispherical temperature
definition: Cone height is half its base width. ASTM HT and CEN HE are the same point under two standards, so they are one parameter measured two ways

name: Ash flow temperature
definition: The ash has spread to a flat layer. ASTM fluid temperature (FT) and CEN flow temperature (FL) are the same point

name: Acid insoluble lignin (Klason)
definition: The residue after acid hydrolysis. A DIFFERENT FRACTION from acid soluble lignin, not a better measurement of it: the two sum to total lignin and a source reporting both reports two numbers

name: Acid soluble lignin
definition: The lignin that dissolves during acid hydrolysis, measured on the hydrolysate by UV. Lost entirely by a Klason determination that reports only the residue

name: Extractives
definition: Matter removed by a solvent before the wall is analysed. THE SOLVENT IS A METHOD: hot water, 95% ethanol and ethanol/toluene recover different and overlapping sets from one material, and a source may report all three. Registering a parameter per solvent would make every new solvent a catalogue edit - the same trade dry_matter settled for drying temperature

name: Arabinan
definition: Anhydro-arabinose in the wall. A C5 sugar

name: Xylan
definition: Anhydro-xylose, the dominant hemicellulose backbone in cereal walls. A C5 sugar

name: Mannan
definition: Anhydro-mannose. A C6 sugar

name: Galactan
definition: Anhydro-galactose. A C6 sugar

name: Glucan
definition: Anhydro-glucose. CAUTION, and it is why this is not cellulose: on a starchy material the glucan figure includes the starch, which is how potato mash reads 86,40 wt% dry glucan against 3,09 cellulose

name: Rhamnan
definition: Anhydro-rhamnose, a pectin-associated sugar

name: Total C5 sugars
definition: The source's own sum of its five-carbon monomers. Not recomputed here - a sum reflects which sugars that laboratory looked for

name: Total C6 sugars
definition: The source's own sum of its six-carbon monomers

name: Total non-structural carbohydrates
definition: Sugars, starch and fructans together - the carbohydrate that is not cell wall. A forage-science determination; distinct from total_sugars, which excludes starch

name: Non-starch polysaccharides
definition: The cell-wall and other polysaccharide carbohydrate that is not starch and not sugar. CVB is explicit that it does NOT determine this - section 4.2.2.5: `Het gehalte aan NSPh wordt niet bepaald, maar [berekend]`, as OS - RE - RVETh - ZETam - GOS - CF_DI*SUI. Every CVB value for it is therefore value_origin `calculated`, and CVB warns it can come out NEGATIVE when the subtracted fractions are overstated

name: Residual non-starch polysaccharides
definition: CVB's RNSP, and its own definition (section 3.4.2.7) is `rest-NSP = NSP - NDF` - the non-starch polysaccharide that the neutral-detergent extraction does not recover, chiefly pectins and soluble fibre. A DIFFERENT FRACTION from nsp, not a second measurement of it. Calculated, and it too can be negative

name: Phytate phosphorus
definition: CVB's IP - the phosphorus bound as inositol hexaphosphate, which is the fraction monogastrics cannot release. A distinct analyte from total phosphorus, and the ratio IP/P is what a source prints when it wants to say how available the phosphorus is

name: Molybdenum (Mo)
definition: Trace element

name: Iodine (I)
definition: Trace element. CVB heads the column `J`, the Dutch abbreviation for jodium

name: Cobalt (Co)
definition: Trace element

name: Oligosaccharides
definition: CVB's GOS - the raffinose-family oligosaccharides. Reported separately from total sugars because CVB subtracts it separately when it computes NSP, and it is the fraction that makes legume meals ferment

name: Inorganic sulphur
definition: CVB's S-a. The sulphate-bound sulphur, DETERMINED. CVB section 3 warns it varies strongly between batches of the same material and that its standard deviation is the thing to read. A different fraction from organic sulphur, not a different measurement of one thing - the two sum to total sulphur, which is why sheets printing S-a and S-o print no S

name: Organic sulphur
definition: CVB's S-o, and it is NOT DETERMINED: CVB p. 19 gives it as S-o = 32/149 x MET + 32/120 x CYS, computed from the two sulphur-bearing amino acids. Every value is therefore value_origin `calculated`, and it misses sulphur held in any other organic compound - CVB says so itself
